n64d910c9f1.headline: Inflation: Kickl for „Austria Basket“
n64d910c9f1.summary: FPÖ chairman Herbert Kickl supports an 'Austria basket' for the food trade to address inflation, citing Greece as a model for the approach.
n64d910c9f1.why: Austria's inflation rate affects consumer prices, wage bargaining and the interest-rate outlook for euro-area bonds. Food retail pricing is a key component of consumer inflation.

n1958076c4b.headline: Does the sale of Dominion Voting Systems mean a transformation? Depends who's asking
n1958076c4b.summary: Dominion Voting Systems has been sold, and its new owner has given contrasting messages about how much the business will change. The company is tied to claims about the 2020 US election.
n1958076c4b.why: Dominion is a US election technology vendor, and changes in ownership can affect its contracts with government customers. Private equity and strategic acquisitions in this sector are closely watched.

n0ee5497c27.headline: Charities urge Rachel Reeves to avoid 'new tax' on most vulnerable
n0ee5497c27.summary: A group of 15 charities and firms, including Disability Rights UK, wrote to Chancellor Rachel Reeves warning a proposed new tax would make essential travel unaffordable for vulnerable people.
n0ee5497c27.why: The UK Chancellor of the Exchequer sets fiscal policy and taxation, which affects public finances, consumer spending and gilt market expectations.

n4cc3bdda51.headline: National Disruption Group to be established to crush tobacco black market
n4cc3bdda51.summary: A new National Disruption Group will be convened to stamp out the exploding illicit tobacco market and other converging threats, the home affairs minister announced.
n4cc3bdda51.why: Illicit tobacco trade evades excise tax, reducing government revenue and undercutting legal tobacco producers and retailers.

n5bfe3b7d69.headline: Social Security 2026 COLA Forecasts Have Gotten Bigger. Here's How Much Your Benefit Could Increase Next Year.
n5bfe3b7d69.summary: Analysts have raised their forecasts for the 2026 cost-of-living adjustment to Social Security benefits. The increases follow President Trump's tariffs, which have spurred inflation.
n5bfe3b7d69.why: The COLA is the annual inflation-linked increase in US Social Security benefits, and forecasts track consumer price inflation.

n4a06d85891.headline: UK households warned over 'double taxation' from HMRC in shake-up
n4a06d85891.summary: The Labour government's Chancellor has been warned that raising capital gains tax again could backfire. The warning concerns a planned shake-up affecting UK households.
n4a06d85891.why: Capital gains tax changes affect investment behaviour, asset sales, and government revenue in the UK.

n98bd34b209.headline: Spy Games and Superyachts: Inside the Italy-China Power Struggle Rocking Luxury Shipyards
n98bd34b209.summary: The dispute between Italian luxury yacht maker Ferretti's management and its top Chinese investor has returned to the spotlight, according to Bloomberg reporting.
n98bd34b209.why: Ferretti is a major Italian luxury yacht manufacturer, and shareholder disputes can affect governance, strategy and investor confidence.

n3389df7ae6.headline: ICICI vs HDFC Bank Q2 earnings: Steady growth, improving asset quality
n3389df7ae6.summary: India's two largest private banks, ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank, posted second-quarter results showing steady growth and improving asset quality.
n3389df7ae6.why: ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank are the two largest private-sector lenders in India, so their results are a benchmark for the health of the Indian banking system.

impacts.name: ICICI Bank
impacts.why: Steady growth and improving asset quality in quarterly results support the bank's earnings outlook.

nda572a9fb9.headline: Gold Weekly Forecast: Dovish Fed, Geopolitics Keep Gold Underpinned
nda572a9fb9.summary: Gold rallied sharply to an all-time high near $4,380 an ounce before pulling back toward $4,200 this week. Analysts cited a dovish Federal Reserve and geopolitics.
nda572a9fb9.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset and a store of value that investors use to hedge inflation and geopolitical risk. Its price is closely tied to real interest rates and the US dollar.

nb442814bbc.headline: The truth behind your clothing’s ‘made in Guatemala’ label
nb442814bbc.summary: A CNN report examines workers at industrial buildings in Guatemala City who produce garments sold with 'made in Guatemala' labels.
nb442814bbc.why: Garment manufacturing is a major export industry for Guatemala, and labour conditions in apparel supply chains affect brand sourcing decisions.

n089e732d91.headline: Milan's data centre capacity set to surge tenfold in five years, A2A CEO says
n089e732d91.summary: Data centres around Milan are expected to add about two gigawatts of capacity over five years, a tenfold increase from current levels. A2A's chief executive made the forecast.
n089e732d91.why: A2A is an Italian energy group, and data centre power demand is a growing driver of electricity and infrastructure investment.

n3cbd5e17ca.headline: Retail inflation for farm,  rural workers eases
n3cbd5e17ca.summary: Retail inflation for farm workers eased to -0.07% and for rural workers to 0.31% in September, down from 1.07% and 1.26% in August, Labour Ministry data showed.
n3cbd5e17ca.why: India's rural inflation indices track price pressures on lower-income households and help shape expectations for the Reserve Bank of India's policy decisions.

ncb0b0c2979.headline: Court reduces damages Meta will get from spyware maker NSO Group but bans it from WhatsApp
ncb0b0c2979.summary: US District Judge Phyllis Hamilton reduced damages Meta will receive from NSO Group from $167 million to $4 million. She also ordered the Israeli spyware maker to stop targeting WhatsApp.
ncb0b0c2979.why: Meta Platforms owns WhatsApp and Facebook, and its legal battles over user security affect its costs and regulatory exposure. NSO Group is an Israeli spyware company.

nb08a4172cc.headline: Trade talks are on in cordial atmosphere with US;  farmer, MSME interest will be protected: Goyal
nb08a4172cc.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India-US talks on a proposed bilateral trade agreement are progressing in a cordial atmosphere. He said New Delhi will protect the interests of farmers and small businesses.
nb08a4172cc.why: A bilateral trade deal would alter tariffs and market access between India and the US, affecting exporters, farmers and small manufacturers in India.

n105f16b73d.headline: ICICI Bank net profit grows 5.2% to Rs 12,359 crore
n105f16b73d.summary: ICICI Bank's September-quarter net profit rose a modest 5.2% to Rs 12,359 crore. The increase was held back by a significant slump in treasury income, though the input cites core operations as a further factor.
n105f16b73d.why: ICICI Bank is one of India's largest private-sector lenders, and its earnings are a bellwether for the country's banking sector.

impacts.name: ICICI Bank
impacts.why: Profit grew 5.2%, but a slump in treasury income weighed on the result.

nd08f73e684.headline: Oman's foreign investment surges past RO 30 billion
nd08f73e684.summary: Foreign direct investment in Oman reached approximately RO 30.279 billion by the end of the second quarter of 2025. The figure signals strong foreign capital inflows.
nd08f73e684.why: Foreign direct investment indicates how much overseas capital is committed to a country's businesses and projects, which matters for growth and currency outlooks.

nf72977a0bc.headline: France downgraded by S&P as budget uncertainty ‘remains elevated’
nf72977a0bc.summary: S&P cut France's credit rating, saying budget uncertainty remains elevated. The move follows Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu's commitment to suspend an unpopular law raising the retirement age.
nf72977a0bc.why: Sovereign credit ratings affect the borrowing costs of governments and the pricing of their bonds. France is the euro area's second-largest economy by GDP.
nf72977a0bc.why_moved: S&P cited elevated budget uncertainty in France. The downgrade follows a government commitment to suspend a pension-age law, which investors weigh against fiscal risk.

nfe9708179c.headline: US-China talks planned next week as Trump plays down tariffs
nfe9708179c.summary: US-China trade talks are set for next week to negotiate down escalatory measures between the two largest economies. Trump has played down tariffs.
nfe9708179c.why: The US and China are the world's two largest economies, and their tariff disputes affect global trade, supply chains and corporate earnings.
nfe9708179c.why_moved: Trade talks to negotiate down escalatory measures could reduce tariff uncertainty between the two largest economies, but the input gives no outcome.

n20372d93a2.headline: Government will not rush to bail out exporters hit by US’s 50% tariff
n20372d93a2.summary: The Indian government is unlikely to rush ahead with a package to aid exporters hit by Trump's 50% tariff, as it has yet to get a full assessment of the situation.
n20372d93a2.why: US tariffs on Indian goods affect export-oriented sectors and the broader trade balance of India, a major exporter to the US.

n5e830d8d7d.headline: Buying gold on Dhanteras: Yellow metal at record high; what will drive sales today?
n5e830d8d7d.summary: Gold prices in India reached a record Rs 1,34,800 per 10 grams ahead of Dhanteras, which may dent volume sales while lifting the value of sales.
n5e830d8d7d.why: Gold is a major store of value and jewellery demand driver in India, and its price influences import bills and household savings.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Domestic gold prices in India hit a record, tracking the strong global gold price trend.

n0e0296eae8.headline: Major bank: Australian dollar surge to 69 cents
n0e0296eae8.summary: The Australian dollar gained as the US dollar index fell. Gold, base metals and miners rose, while oil weakened and emerging-market stocks reached highs, according to the market wrap.
n0e0296eae8.why: The Australian dollar is heavily influenced by commodity prices and China demand, given Australia's large mining and resource exports.

n8e9072d3e4.headline: Trump, Munir and Sharif: The ventriloquist, the dummy, and the deal for a ‘Chinese takeaway’
n8e9072d3e4.summary: Pakistani leaders Shehbaz Sharif and Asim Munir visited Donald Trump in the Oval Office to discuss their nations' relationship and a proposed deal, with Trump questioning Pakistan's alliance with China.
n8e9072d3e4.why: US-Pakistan relations affect trade, security assistance and access to strategic minerals, which matter for investors in the region and in critical-material supply chains.

nb3c7638cad.headline: President Mahama’s China diplomacy powers Ghana’s 24-hour economy and green transformation
nb3c7638cad.summary: Ghana and China agree on a zero tariff deal, enhancing trade volumes and investment flows between the two countries.
nb3c7638cad.why: Trade agreements like tariff reductions can significantly impact export growth and economic relations.

n598c2acaf7.headline: Cong protests against alleged electoral malpractice | Mysuru News
n598c2acaf7.summary: Congress protests electoral malpractice in Mysuru, reflecting political tensions that can influence regional stability.
n598c2acaf7.why: Political unrest can affect local markets, investor confidence, and government stability.

n53e3c0e8de.headline: Brexit impact on UK economy ‘negative for foreseeable future,’ Bailey says
n53e3c0e8de.summary: The Bank of England governor highlighted a decline in the UK's potential growth rate due to Brexit's economic effects.
n53e3c0e8de.why: A lower potential growth rate affects fiscal policy, investment, and currency stability in the UK.

na35b627e19.headline: Natural gas has the potential to be a bridge to renewable energy in Mexico
na35b627e19.summary: Half of Mexico’s electricity is generated with imported gas, but experts suggest diversification for sustainability.
na35b627e19.why: Energy mix decisions influence energy security, costs, and climate commitments.

n1af7af66bf.headline: Purge unlike any other: Nine top Chinese generals expelled — Why Xi Jinping is cleaning house again
n1af7af66bf.summary: China’s President Xi Jinping has expelled nine senior military generals as part of a sweeping purge.
n1af7af66bf.why: Military purges can impact China's defense sector and signal internal political shifts affecting economic stability.

nf8d2e9ce2c.headline: Extradition case: Nirav Modi signals 'sensational developments' ahead of hearing; expresses hope for bail or discharge
nf8d2e9ce2c.summary: The diamond trader anticipates major legal updates in his extradition proceedings from the UK to India.
nf8d2e9ce2c.why: High-profile legal cases involving financial crimes can influence banking sector reputation and investor trust.

n152561be79.headline: Brexit impact on UK economy ‘negative for foreseeable future,’ Bailey says
n152561be79.summary: Bank of England governor Bailey states Brexit has a negative impact on the UK’s potential growth rate, affecting economic prospects.
n152561be79.why: Brexit-related economic challenges influence UK growth, investment, and monetary policy outlooks.
